overall: The AG found the Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting a list of documents used from its December 10, 2019 minutes, ordered amendment within 60 days, and found the minutes otherwise sufficiently detailed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the December 10, 2019 meeting failed to include a list of the documents used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law where it did not include in the minutes of the December 10 meeting a list of documents used at that meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the December 10, 2019 meeting were insufficiently detailed and contained inaccurate statements.
allegations.key_passage: With respect to the allegation that the minutes of the December 10 meeting are insufficiently detailed, we find that the Board substantially complied with the requirement that it provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion that occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint raised other issues and concerns that do not concern the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government interprets and enforces the Open Meeting Law only; therefore, we decline to review any allegations that do not allege a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.

allegations.summary: Any allegations not timely filed with the Board were not reviewed.
allegations.key_passage: Likewise, we decline to review any allegations that were not timely filed with the Board.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the December 10, 2019 meeting within sixty days to include a list of all documents used at the meeting.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to amend the minutes of its December 10, 2019, meeting within sixty days to include a list of all documents used at the meeting.
